name: crm
description: CRM and sales pipeline management for systemprompt.io. Tracks leads from first touch through conversion, manages deals and pipeline stages, drafts and sends emails via Resend API (human-approved, never automatic), produces daily sales strategy briefs, and logs every action as a falsifiable hypothesis. Complements marketing-strategy (which handles top-of-funnel) with mid-funnel pipeline management and direct customer engagement.
